description: This file defines an abstract class 'AggregateBase' which contains helper methods used for statistical calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling boolean acceptance and countability checks.

classes.name: AggregateBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing utility methods for statistical aggregate functions.

methods.name: testAcceptedBoolean
methods.description: Checks if a boolean value should be accepted based on the compatibility mode and context (cell value or literal).

methods.name: isAcceptedCountable
methods.description: Determines if a value is countable in statistical functions considering nulls, numeric types, and cell context.
